quote: If the driver of a vehicle intends to turn at an intersection and: Both intersecting highways are two-directional: Except as otherwise directed by official traffic-control devices, simultaneous left turns by opposing traffic must be made in front of each other.

activation.condition: A driver intends to turn left at an intersection where both intersecting highways are two-directional and opposing traffic also turns left.

obligation.description: Simultaneous opposing left turns must be made in front of each other when no applicable official traffic-control device directs otherwise.

exceptions.source_clause: Except as otherwise directed by official traffic-control devices
exceptions.description: An applicable official device may direct an alternate passing order; actual instruction and legal scope require original operator review.

timing.description: Observe both vehicles through the common left-turn interval and determine front/rear relationship from original synchronized geometry.

judgment_calls_needed.note: Original approach-road lane directions and selected junction topology require source review.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: simultaneous left turns by opposing traffic must be made in front of each other
judgment_calls_needed.note: Original joined body/heading frames establish candidate simultaneity and relative geometry; legal front-passing interpretation remains reviewable.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: except as otherwise directed by official traffic-control devices
judgment_calls_needed.note: An exact-map operator survey may record a device instruction; legal applicability and both-approach scope remain unreviewed.
